_comment_1: Merge the acp entry INSIDE the existing mcpServers object of your client config. Do not replace the whole file. Claude Desktop: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
_comment_2: command must be an absolute path to a Python interpreter that has mcp, pydantic and ansys-acp-core installed. Backslashes must be doubled in JSON; forward slashes also work.
_comment_3: ACP_BRIDGE_PATH points at acp_gui_bridge.py. It only shapes the error message the server prints when the live bridge is unreachable, but keeping it correct saves a lookup later.
_comment_4: Restart the client completely after editing - MCP servers and the tool list are read once at startup.
